entries.title: Borrowing and answering for another
entries.literal_meaning: I would borrow, but would not become surety for someone else.
entries.explanation: The dictionary’s inline explanation distinguishes taking a loan from guaranteeing another person. The first-person voice accepts one involvement and refuses the other. Our reading hears a boundary between bearing one’s own obligation and answering for someone else; it does not turn that preference into a rule everyone should follow.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନର ସଂଲଗ୍ନ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଋଣ ନେବା ଓ ଅନ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ଜାମିନ ହେବାକୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ। ବକ୍ତା ଗୋଟିଏ ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ପଶିବାକୁ ମାନେ, ଅନ୍ୟଟିକୁ ମନା କରେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ନିଜ ଦାୟ ନେବା ଓ ପର ପାଇଁ ଉତ୍ତରଦାୟୀ ହେବା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସୀମା ଶୁଣାଯାଏ; ସେ ପସନ୍ଦ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ନିୟମ ହୋଇଯାଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears a speaker distinguishing two kinds of obligation.
entries.odia_summary: ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରକାର ଦାୟକୁ ଅଲଗା କରୁଥିବା ବକ୍ତାକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ଶୁଣେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, “କଥାଟିରେ ଋଣଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଦାୟର ଭେଦ ମୋତେ ଶୁଣାଯାଉଛି।” ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ନିଜ ପାଇଁ କହିବା ଓ ପର ପାଇଁ କଥା ଦେବା କି ଏକା?” / A reading group discusses the difference between speaking for oneself and giving one’s word for someone else. This discussion is invented, not borrowing advice.
entries.cultural_context: Sambalpur labels the dictionary’s verb, not a proven saying origin. The gloss supplies surety; this historical wording offers no present financial or legal guidance.

entries.odia: କାହାଗେ କହିବି ଶୁଣିବ କେ? ସାଆନ୍ତ ଅବୁଝା ମାରିବ ଯେ
entries.title: Who will listen?
entries.literal_meaning: To whom shall I speak; who will listen? The master does not understand and will strike.
entries.explanation: The question about a listener is followed by the speaker’s expectation of a blow. Our reading hears the difficulty of speaking when the person with authority seems unwilling to understand. The line voices an expectation; it does not document an assault or establish how every master behaves.
entries.meaning_odia: ଶୁଣିବା ଲୋକ କିଏ ବୋଲି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ପରେ ବକ୍ତା ମାଡ଼ ଆଶଙ୍କା କରେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ କ୍ଷମତା ଥିବା ଲୋକ ବୁଝିବାକୁ ରାଜି ନଥିବା ମନେହେଲେ କଥା କହିବାର ଅସୁବିଧା ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। କଥାଟି ଆଶଙ୍କା ପ୍ରକାଶ କରେ; ପ୍ରକୃତ ଆକ୍ରମଣର ବିବରଣୀ ବା ସବୁ ସାଆନ୍ତଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟବହାରର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears an anxious search for someone willing to listen.
entries.odia_summary: ଶୁଣିବାକୁ ରାଜି ଲୋକଟିଏ ଖୋଜିବାର ଉଦ୍ବେଗ ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଏକ ଗଳ୍ପ ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ବକ୍ତାକୁ କିଏ ଶୁଣିପାରିବ?” ଦଳଟି ଏମିତି ଏକ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଦୃଶ୍ୟ କଳ୍ପନା କଲା ଯେଉଁଠି କେହି କଥା ନକାଟି ଶୁଣେ। / Discussing a story, readers ask who could hear the speaker out. They imagine a following scene in which someone listens without interruption. This peaceful continuation is invented, not part of the source.
entries.cultural_context: The source illustrates an emphatic particle. Its neighbouring literary quotations do not identify this saying’s author. The authority-and-listening application is editorial, not a supplied historical incident.
